codeReview.summary: Current repo state still contains the extracted provider modules, GPT-4o-mini usage, `extractIntent()` JSON mode, and the single shared query embedding passed to memory and RAG search. However, the prior blocking scrutiny finding is still unresolved: the only feature-specific tests added by commit 7455b1d remain tautological and do not import or execute the LLM or embeddings providers, and no later commit has updated those test files. I did not find an additional resolved fix for this feature in the current repo. Separately, the advisory prompt still puts context blocks into the user message instead of the system prompt required by the feature description.

issues.description: The prior blocking issue remains unresolved. This file still contains no import or invocation of `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/providers/llm.ts`; tests beginning at line 137 only assert local literals and helper output (for example `const expectedModel = 'gpt-4o-mini'` and locally constructed `messages`). Repo-wide search found no test that calls `chatCompletion()` or `extractIntent()`, so VAL-BE-010/011 and JSON-mode extraction behavior are still not meaningfully verified.

The prior blocking issue remains unresolved here as well. This file still does not import or execute `generateEmbedding()` or the real memory/RAG call sites; the tests at and after line 112 assert constants or hand-built objects such as `sharedEmbedding` instead of exercising the provider. Repo-wide search found no test that calls `generateEmbedding()`, so the OpenAI embedding behavior and single-embedding reuse optimization still are not behaviorally validated.

The advisory provider still appends `contextBlocks` to the user message (`role: 'user'` at lines 68-69) while the system message at lines 64-65 contains only language and safety instructions. That does not match the feature description's requirement to inject farm, memory, RAG, and attachment context into the advisory system prompt.
